notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR detail page is substantive; it gives registration, coordinates, elevation and height, but no build date, administrator or history. The YouTube page was used only for its title. The brief's rumble.com source was not cited because it added nothing beyond the county. Brief's elevation (146.3 m) and registration date match the register; no corrections. 'Standing' rests on the register's present tense, not a confirmed condition. anyplaceamerica.com returned HTTP 403. A second source for the tower's history would be needed to say more. Fact-check 2026-10-09: every footnoted claim and quote matched the register page; no story edits were needed.
